row.evidence: Document360's pricing page shows no plans ("We quote what fits") and lists SSO and SCIM as security features; its docs say SCIM lets your Identity Provider automatically sync users, readers, and groups.
row.notes: Quote-only: the pricing page publishes no tiers or prices, and SSO and security needs are named as one of the six price drivers, so the SCIM plan is not public. SCIM is set up inside an SAML/OIDC SSO configuration (SSO required). Okta and Entra (non-gallery custom app; the Entra gallery app is SSO only) provision users, readers and groups; OneLogin provisions readers only. SCIM deactivate and delete both leave the profile Inactive in Document360. API docs say API access is on Business, Enterprise and Trial plans, and user create/delete/role/group write endpoints are a premium API add-on.

plans.price_text: Customized pricing built around your needs (no public tiers)

auth.token_source: Settings > Users & permissions > SSO Configuration > (SSO setup) > SCIM provisioning: Enable SCIM Provisioning shows SCIM Base URL plus primary and secondary secret tokens
auth.notes: Okta enters the token in 'HTTP Header Authorization'; two tokens allow rotation; tokens shown once.

operations.notes: Okta guide enables Create Users, Update User Attributes and Deactivate Users; whether updates arrive as PUT or PATCH is not documented. An IdP delete only sets the profile Inactive.

deprovision.data_retained: Profile is kept with Inactive status (also after an IdP delete); per the deactivation article, content, analytics and audit data are retained and the account can be reactivated.
deprovision.notes: frees_seat comes from the general 'Deactivate or delete user' article, which applies to inactive users; SCIM pages do not restate it.

custom.how: Extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:document360:2.0:User with userType (string: user, reviewer, reader) and legacy isTeamAccount (boolean)

roles.how: userType attribute (user / reviewer / reader) or legacy isTeamAccount boolean, often set via IdP expressions; portal role for Users comes from the 'Default role' set on the SCIM provisioning page.

limitations.text: OneLogin SCIM provisions readers only; users and groups are not supported.
Entra SCIM requires a non-gallery (custom) enterprise app and SAML; OIDC with Entra does not support SCIM.
SCIM-pushed groups always create a new Document360 group rather than linking an existing one.
Once SCIM is enabled, user names cannot be edited and users cannot be deleted inside Document360.
SCIM fails to provision once the plan's User limit is reached.
Auto assign reader group (JIT for SSO readers) and SCIM cannot both be active on one SSO configuration.

auth.notes: API keys carry a portal role, content role and content-access scope rather than OAuth scopes.

rate_limits.text: Per API key per project: Business 120 read / 60 write requests per minute; Enterprise and Trial 200 / 100.

limitations.text: User create/delete, role and group write endpoints are premium API endpoints, a paid add-on enabled via the Customer Success Manager.

okta.notes: Document360's Okta guide uses an Okta app with SCIM Provisioning enabled in App Settings; okta.com/integrations/document360/ returned 404, so no OIN listing was confirmed.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO only; SCIM works only with a non-gallery custom app.

onelogin.notes: Uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML' app; readers only.

fallbacks.notes: JIT applies to readers (Auto assign reader group, enabled by support) not to team accounts.
